frontmatter.name: code-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews the uncommitted working-tree changes against the repo's Review Rule Set and returns findings as one JSON object. Also runs a non-waivable security scan on every changed file, raising BLOCKER findings no instruction can override. Spawn after an implement or write-test agent finishes, or when the user asks to review current changes. Read-only on project source.

frontmatter.name: execution-path-analyzer
frontmatter.description: Traces every execution path through the functions an implement phase changed (branches, early returns, error paths, boundary cases) and writes an EPA report for write-test to consume, one path per test. Spawn only when the user has asked for tests, after every coding phase is implemented and reviewed, before write-test. Read-only on project source.

frontmatter.name: explore
frontmatter.description: Researches one task and writes ONE research document: what the code does, plus what any technology the repo does not already use documents about itself, every page cited by URL and date. The only agent with web search. Spawn when a request is ambiguous, an area is unfamiliar, approaches need weighing, or it depends on an unfamiliar service, SDK, library, or API. Repeatable: spawn per repo, per area, and again whenever the user changes the request. Reports findings only, never requirements or deliverables. Read-only on project source.

frontmatter.name: fact-check
frontmatter.description: Checks a spec or plan for claims that would break the implement agent, and for external facts that no longer trace to a cited page, returning one {verdict, target, findings} object. Mandatory after generate-spec and after plan, before either is shown for approval: ultracode_gate refuses approval without a recorded PASS. Its spawn sets how far it goes: `Prior findings:` scopes a re-pass to the previous findings plus changed text, and `Source check:` decides whether it re-opens cited pages. Read-only on project source.

frontmatter.name: generate-spec
frontmatter.description: Reads EVERY research document the request produced and writes exactly ONE spec file: requirements in EARS notation with Given/When/Then criteria, grouped into ordered deliverables, plus the contracts and an External Evidence table carrying each cited external fact forward. It derives the criteria itself and resolves conflicting documents toward the newest. Spawn once per request, after all exploration has finished, whenever a code-changing request needs a plan. States WHAT, never HOW. Read-only on project source.

frontmatter.name: hub-wait
frontmatter.description: Blocks on the cross-harness hub and returns the first message, task notice, or completion notice as JSON with the advanced cursor. Spawn whenever an orchestrate or hub-listen session must wait: this spawn is the only place a session waits, and the parent never calls a hub tool directly. Decides nothing and touches no files.

frontmatter.name: implement
frontmatter.description: Writes the code for one plan phase: loads the skills the orchestrator names, follows the repo's convention skill, verifies each step with the profile's build command, and reports what changed. Spawn when code must be created, modified, or deleted, or to fix code-reviewer findings or a verification failure. Does all coding itself and never delegates back.

frontmatter.name: initializer
frontmatter.description: Bootstraps a repo for ultracode, grounding every generated skill in a real captured exemplar rather than an invented framework pattern. Spawned only by /init-kit, in the mode its `Mode:` parameter names: `detect` (find an existing cross-harness bootstrap, else plan the scout), `scout` (fanned out per repo slice to capture recurring component patterns), `propose` (merge findings into a skill proposal for approval), `generate-skill` (fanned out per approved skill), `generate-inventory` (assemble INVENTORY.md and repo-profile.json), `adopt` (copy another harness's setup into this one).

frontmatter.name: module-documentation
frontmatter.description: Creates or updates the module-hub area references under `.claude/skills/module-hub/references/` from what the implement phases actually changed, grounding every documented name in real source. Optional final step: spawn only when the user asks for documentation, after every phase has passed review. Edits only the references directory.

frontmatter.name: plan
frontmatter.description: Turns one approved spec into a master plan plus one self-contained file per phase, each step naming an exact path, a prose action, the skills to load, and a verification command. Phases are tagged with their repo and dependencies so the orchestrator can parallelize. Spawn once after spec approval, when work must be sequenced across files, modules, or repos. Reads the spec and nothing else. Read-only on project source.

frontmatter.name: prompt-generation
frontmatter.description: Writes or edits instruction files (LLM system prompts, SKILL.md skills, subagent definitions) to the meta-author standard. Spawn when creating or improving any prompt or skill, or when debugging ambiguous-instruction failures.

frontmatter.name: write-test
frontmatter.description: Writes tests covering the paths the EPA report identifies, following the repo's test skills. Spawn only when the user has asked for tests, after every coding phase is implemented and reviewed, or to fix test-related review findings. Never on the orchestrator's own initiative and never between coding phases. Writes ONLY test code.

frontmatter.name: meta-author
frontmatter.description: Authoring standard for any instruction file — SKILL.md skills, subagent markdown files, and LLM system prompts. ACTIVATE when creating or editing a skill, an agent definition, or an AI prompt. Encodes the 15 Writing Laws, Chain-of-Thought structure, and a mandatory self-review checklist so the output is executable by any model on the first pass without re-reading or guessing.
